text: `atomic_load` shall return the current iN; `atomic_store` shall replace it. `atomic_rmw` shall return the old value and install `xchg`, modular `add/sub`, or bitwise `and/or/xor` with its operand in one indivisible action. Other RMW kinds shall be rejected.
clause_basis: Conservative sentence/semicolon seed groups; semantic clause review required before closure.
